interface.name: rustyos_app_menu_manager_v1

description.summary: Global Menu Bar export manager for native Wayland applications

interface.description: Allows Wayland clients to export structured File/Edit/View/Window/Help menu bar sections for a toplevel wl_surface and receive item activation events directly from the compositor Menu Bar.

request.name: get_menu_surface

description.summary: attach a global menu exporter to a wl_surface

request.description: Creates a rustyos_surface_app_menu_v1 controller bound to the given surface.

interface.name: rustyos_surface_app_menu_v1

description.summary: Per-surface Menu Bar tree exporter and activation receiver

interface.description: Clients bracket updates with begin_update -> begin_section / add_item -> commit. When the user clicks an exported item in the compositor Menu Bar, the compositor emits item_activated with the application-defined item id.

description.summary: destroy the menu controller and clear its exported menus
clear pending menu sections prior to repopulating them
start a new top-level Menu Bar section
append an item or separator to the current section

arg.name: shortcut
arg.summary: optional shortcut hint or empty string

arg.name: separator
arg.summary: 1 if horizontal separator, 0 for normal row

description.summary: publish pending sections atomically to the compositor Menu Bar
user activated an exported Menu Bar item
